submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: game space texture. Paint one full-bleed seamless square deep celestial space material, requested 2048x2048, opaque. Attached two reference images guide only refined clean Daoist Q hand-painted finish and jade/ivory/warm-gold taste. Absolutely no UI, borders, panels, lettering, buildings, people, planets or large individual objects. Dense very small naturally scattered warm ivory and muted jade star pinpoints across a deep nearly-black blue-green sky, with extremely subtle hand-painted dark jade gaseous wisps, faint muted warm-gold dust. Low contrast, even brightness across the square, no vignette, no central focal object, no bright enormous flare. Visually distinct from a panorama: this square is a quiet repeating space material sampled by a game shader, all four edges should tile seamlessly. Tiny stars retain varied independent spacing without grid patterns. Beautifully refined illustrative game texture, pure unobstructed space.
